headline: Thu–weekend Bristol kids shortlist (10–13 Sep)
summary: NEW: Winterbourne Saturday Lego, today’s Staple Hill / Emersons Green / Horfield / Bedminster / Hanham morning rhymes — plus still-true Cadbury Heath Lego before refurb, Thu–Fri Crafternoons, Blaise Saturday, Tiny Planet in Bath. Aardman free trail corrected to through 1 Nov (not ending Sun). Harbour trains this weekend CANCELLED.

notices.title: Weather (Met Office Bristol)
notices.detail: Thu 10: dry morning then cloudier, rain chance rising from ~1pm (30–60% mid/late afternoon), high ~19°C, breezy. Fri 11: improving after damp overnight — sunny intervals ~22°C, rain chance low daytime. Sat 12: sunny intervals ~22°C, rain chance rises ~30–40% from mid-afternoon. Sun 13: brighter after early damp (~50% early), drying ~22°C. Outdoor viable Fri–Sun mornings; watch Thu afternoon rain and Sat late.

notices.title: Harbour railway this weekend
notices.detail: M Shed Bristol Harbour Railway train rides on Sat 12 & Sun 13 Sep are CANCELLED (organiser notice). Next advertised weekend is 26–27 Sep — call 0117 352 6600 to confirm before travel.

notices.title: Aardman mini-museum hunt dates
notices.detail: Organiser page now lists Mini-museum hunt! 50 years of Aardman at BMAG as 13 Feb–1 Nov 2026 (not ending 13 Sep). Free trail still available Tue–Sun.

datedPicks.title: Lego club at Winterbourne Library
datedPicks.location: Winterbourne Library, Flaxpits Lane, Winterbourne BS36 1LA
datedPicks.description: Free monthly Saturday Lego club for primary-aged children; adult must accompany. Creative build session on the north fringe.
datedPicks.whyPicked: NEW free Saturday Lego never featured — fills north-fringe gap without repeating yesterday’s Cadbury Heath hero.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Drop-in; email Winterbourne.Library@southglos.gov.uk. Next dated slots also 10 Oct / 7 Nov / 5 Dec.

datedPicks.title: Crafternoon at Kingswood Library
datedPicks.location: Kingswood Library, Kingswood Civic Centre, High Street, Kingswood BS15 9TR
datedPicks.description: Free weekly after-school crafts for children aged 4+; adult must accompany. Drop-in Friday Crafternoon.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Still-true free Friday craft before weekend Blaise/Lego plans.

datedPicks.title: Lego club at Cadbury Heath Library
datedPicks.location: Cadbury Heath Library, School Road, Cadbury Heath BS30 8EN
datedPicks.description: Free creative Lego club for primary-aged children — listen to stories/poems then build a model to display. Adult must accompany. Dated Saturday session before Cadbury Heath Library closes for refurbishment from 21 September.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Still-true free Saturday Lego with refurb urgency — yesterday’s hero (reminder only for email).
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Drop-in; email CadburyHeath.Library@southglos.gov.uk. Library closes for refurb from 21 Sep (reopens 14 Dec).

datedPicks.title: Lego club at Patchway Library
datedPicks.location: Patchway Library, Rodway Road, Patchway BS34 5PE
datedPicks.description: Free monthly Saturday Lego club for primary-aged children; adult must accompany. Second Saturday of the month drop-in.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Still-true free Saturday Lego north Bristol.

datedPicks.title: Lego club at Kingswood Library
datedPicks.location: Kingswood Library, Kingswood Civic Centre, High Street, Kingswood BS15 9TR
datedPicks.description: Free fortnightly Saturday Lego club for primary-aged children; adult must accompany. Creative build-and-display session.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Still-true free Saturday morning Lego east of the city.

datedPicks.title: Lego club at Staple Hill Library
datedPicks.location: Staple Hill Library, Broad Street, Staple Hill BS16 5LS
datedPicks.description: Free monthly Saturday Lego club for primary-aged children; adult must accompany.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Still-true free Saturday Lego east/north — catalog backup.

datedPicks.title: Blaise 100: Dairy Garden Open Sessions
datedPicks.location: Blaise Dairy Garden, Henbury Road, Bristol BS10 7QS
datedPicks.description: Secret Dairy Garden with open-air amphitheatre, historic planting and Nash-designed Dairy (1803–5). Picnic welcome; Friends of Blaise volunteers on hand.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Still-true free Blaise Saturday secret garden.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Same estate as Community Garden Art Show (9.45am–3pm). Light rain risk rises mid-afternoon Sat — morning window better.

datedPicks.title: Blaise 100: Community Garden Art Show & Café
datedPicks.location: Blaise Museum / Community Garden, Henbury Road, Bristol BS10 7QS
datedPicks.description: Working community garden with ponds, beehives, insect trails and an Art Show plus Garden Café — family-friendly Blaise 100 Saturday.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Still-true free local outdoor community day with kid-friendly trails.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Dogs on leads welcome. Pair with Dairy Garden 11am–1pm.

datedPicks.title: Art club at Filton Library
datedPicks.location: Filton Library, Gloucester Road North, Filton BS34 7BR
datedPicks.description: Free monthly arts and crafts for ages 7–11; adult must accompany. Second Saturday of the month drop-in.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Still-true free Saturday craft slot for 7–11s north of the city.

datedPicks.title: Rhyme and Storytime at Central Library
datedPicks.location: Bristol Central Library, College Green, Bristol BS1 5TL
datedPicks.description: Librarian-led nursery rhymes and songs for babies and toddlers (0–3; storytime suit 1–4). All-year Saturday session; older siblings welcome.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Still-true free central weekend 0–4 with clear official timetable.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: No booking needed (unlike St George). All year for Central.

datedPicks.title: Tiny Planet (Half a String) at the egg
datedPicks.location: the egg, Theatre Royal Bath, 36 Monmouth Street, Bath BA1 2AN
datedPicks.description: Puppet theatre with live folk song and camera projection: a whole world no bigger than a house. Distinctive family show for ages 5+ — book ahead for weekend slots.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Still-true scarce indie puppetry for 5+ on the Bath weekend.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: ~30–40 min from central Bristol. Egg Café opens 30 mins before shows. Book tickets online.

datedPicks.title: Mini-museum hunt! 50 years of Aardman
datedPicks.location: Bristol Museum & Art Gallery, Queens Road, Bristol BS8 1RL
datedPicks.description: Free family detective trail: pick up a map and hunt tiny Aardman treasures hidden around the galleries. Organiser page lists the trail 13 Feb–1 Nov 2026 (not a short summer-only run).
datedPicks.whyPicked: Still-true free all-ages indoor trail — date window corrected this run (through 1 Nov, not ending Sun 13).
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Drop-in, no booking. Separate paid Aardman exhibition at M Shed is frequently sold out — this free hunt is at BMAG only.

evergreen.title: Arnold Art Cart (We Are Family)
evergreen.location: Arnolfini, 16 Narrow Quay, Bristol BS1 4QA (2nd floor)
evergreen.description: Free family makers cart with creative materials and exhibition-inspired activities, topped up by Let’s Make Art. Table-top easels available.
evergreen.whyPicked: Always-on free creative drop-in for families at a harbourside indie gallery.

evergreen.title: Windmill Hill City Farm
evergreen.cost: Check entry info on site (community farm visit)
evergreen.description: Community city farm with animals, gardens and outdoor space — open seven days. Strong local outdoor family default.
evergreen.statusNote: Homepage confirms open 7 days; confirm current entry/donation details on arrival.
evergreen.whyPicked: Local indie outdoor staple when you need a simple farm visit.
